kicker: MEN IN THEIR 50s ALL SAY THE SAME THING
title: 5 mistakes men *regret* at 50

label: MISTAKE 1
head: Trading your health for overtime
sub: The promotion won't carry you up the stairs at 52.

label: MISTAKE 2
head: Buying things to impress people
sub: Nobody remembers your car. Your bank account does.

items.head: Upgrading your life every raise
items.sub: Save half of every raise before you see it.

items.head: Never checking your money
items.sub: Know your net worth. Check it monthly.

label: MISTAKE 5
head: Thinking your job will always be there
sub: Build one skill or income your boss can't take.

text: Your 50-year-old self is built by *what you do* at 25.
